summary: Master the art of hospitality with our specialized training course for international guests. Improve service quality and ensure guest satisfaction effortlessly.
lede: Customer service training for the hospitality industry helps staff serve guests from different cultural and language backgrounds with clarity and respect. It is for front-office, restaurant, housekeeping and other hospitality teams who shape the guest journey. Participants practise cross-cultural communication, use translation tools and visual aids, and handle complaints through listening, de-escalation and service recovery.
audienceIntro: This course is crafted for professionals who directly or indirectly serve international guests, ensuring they can deliver exceptional hospitality service.
audience: Guest relations officers and concierge staff
Restaurant, bar, and F&B service staff
Duty managers and front office managers
modules: Handling Language Barriers and Using Service Tools
Managing the Guest Journey: Before, During, and After the Stay
Handling Complaints and Service Recovery for International Guests
Teamwork Across Departments for Seamless Service
Safety, Security, and Duty of Care for International Guests
Personalizing Service and Creating Memorable Moments
Your Professional Brand in Global Hospitality
prerequisites: No specific prerequisites, but a basic understanding of hospitality operations is recommended.
